title: First rewind step
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine with $S.k$ work tapes and $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine with $A.k$ work tapes. For every Boolean choice $b$, Boolean input $x$, natural number $m$, input-head position $ip \in \mathrm{Fin}(|x|+2)$, tape contents $sT,aT$ and head positions $sP,aP$ for the work tapes of $S$ and $A$, and integer $z$, one step of the host machine from phase $\mathrm{rew}$, with yard tape storing $m$ true symbols from cell zero and its head at $z$, enters phase $\mathrm{rew2}$, moves the input head according to the clamped left move, moves the yard head to $z-1$, and leaves the other work tapes and the output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a deterministic Boolean Turing machine
$A$ is a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine
$sT$ and $aT$ specify work-tape contents for $S$ and $A$
$sP$ and $aP$ specify work-tape head positions for $S$ and $A$
